data.title: Coinbase CEO: $400,000 on Bitcoin by 2030 is a ‘reasonable target’
data.description: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong discusses the Clarity Act and what greater regulatory clarity could mean for the crypto industry. He also explains why the Bitcoin trade has already hit bottom, expecting upside amid pressure in global bond markets.
